missions.request: Create stats.mjs: read a JSON number array from stdin and write count, sum and mean as JSON. Handle an empty array and reject malformed or nonnumeric input. Supply tests; diagnose and fix at least one observed failing case.
acceptance: Retain test evidence and the repair explanation

missions.request: Create a small local website and a server.mjs accepting HOST and PORT. Include a health endpoint. Deploy only within the assigned environment, verify its HTTP responses and retain the launch and shutdown commands.
acceptance: GET / returns HTML and a meaningful title
Server can be stopped and restarted
External publication remains pending operator configuration

missions.request: Produce a report from the operator-supplied source packet. Give each source an identifier, cite factual claims, separate inference from evidence, and describe contradictory or missing evidence.
acceptance: Every material factual claim names a source
Quoted passages match the supplied source
A human checks that sources actually support the claims

limitations: Fixture-based integration tests do not measure model reasoning
No income or trading performance is implied
Model selection and live evaluation remain unperformed until a suitable endpoint is configured
